newsitem.title: KENYA: SOCCER-KENYA GIVES COACH FABISCH FOUR-YEAR CONTRACT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-KENYA GIVES COACH FABISCH FOUR-YEAR CONTRACT.

text.p: The Kenya Football Federation (KFF) has agreed to a new four-year contract for German coach Reinhardt Fabisch when his current one-year term ends in July.
A KFF official said on Tuesday Fabisch's responsiblities would include developing a youth programme.
Fabisch arrived in Kenya last year after an absence of nine years. He had coached the East Africans to the finals of the 4th All Africa Games in Nairobi in 1987.
The Kenyan team, with an average age of 23 and only two professionals, was due to leave Nairobi on Tuesday for a three-week training stint in Germany.
The team will fly to Nigeria for their crucial June 7 World Cup qualifier directly from their training camp near Munich.

Squad - Goalkeepers: Francis Onyiso, Victor Onyango, Duncan Ochieng. Defenders: John Luchuku, Musa Otieno (captain), Josiah Ougo, Oscar Ambani Kambona, Francis Odhiambo, Robert Ochan Olang', Vincent Kwarula. Midfielders: John Odhiambo, Eric Omondi, Eric Ochieng, Seif Mutie, Seleman Rashid, Geoffrey Osama, Edward Karanja. Forwards: Mike Okoth Origi, Tom Ogweno, Mike Mururi, Kennedy Simiyu, Francis Were.
